# Kebra Nagast — questions for the owner

- 2026-10-12 · audio · Pronunciation convention (traditional Ethiopian liturgical, or reconstructed Geʿez) and the voice are not chosen. Decided meanwhile: parts publish without audio; the source line keeps the transliteration convention only.
- 2026-10-16 · ch2-8 · Ch. 8 reads ፷ ነፍስ 'sixty souls' where Genesis 7 has eight; HaCohen's text (not checked against Bezold's print) may be wrong or the manuscript variant. Decided meanwhile: kept the source reading, flagged in the unit note. Please check Bezold p. for ch. 8. Also unsolved: ዘይቈርር እምነ አስሐቲያ (rendered tentatively).
- 2026-10-16 · ch9-12 · Ch. 11 heading reads ፫፻፲ወ፷ (370) where Nicaea's fathers are 318 (ch. 1); same ፷/፰-type issue as ch. 8. Decided meanwhile: kept as printed, flagged. Unresolved words (no Dillmann available): ኢይምሰሎሙ, ጥስየኒ, ያሰግሉ, መማዕልይ, ምጽናዓት, ልጐታተ, ማውታ ወብትከ.
- 2026-10-16 · ch13-16 · Ch. 14 reads ዐሠርተ ወሰመንተ (18) for Abraham's trained men where Genesis 14:14 has 318; a dropped ፫፻ in HaCohen's text is possible. Decided meanwhile: kept as printed, flagged in the unit note. Please check Bezold's print. Unresolved without Dillmann: ኬንያ, ዝልጉሳነ ወዕቡቃነ, ዲባጋተ, ዝጋናተ, ለግልፈዋተ.
- 2026-10-16 · ch17-20 · Ch. 17 furnishings list (unit 13) has about ten words left untranslated and seven guessed (ጸሀራተ, ኰሳኰሳተ, ሠቃሥቃተ, መኃትወ, መሳውረ መራናተ, አዕያገ, አብሕርተ, ደርከኖ, ምጺጺተ ብሳጣተ, ሜላተ ነተ). Ch. 19 ድማትዮስ rendered 'Dematyos' (Demetrius would need ር); ዐረባዊ 'western (?)' vs 'Arabian'. Decided meanwhile: published with flags. Please check Dillmann if convenient.
- 2026-10-17 · ch21-22 · Unresolved without Dillmann: ሣእሣአ አፉሁ, ያክሞስሶሙ, ይእትቱ, ይሤርሖን, ጸቃውዐ መዓር ('honeycomb'?), ብርት / ባሕሩስ / ብርዐ (metals and plants, 1 Kings 10:27), ህንደኬ (India or Candace). Decided meanwhile: published with (?) flags. Ch. 22 unit 11 is 62 words with no ፤ and stays whole.
